objective: Estimate the paired-world change in closed-loop multi-target estimation and resource use for the frozen Stage6 policies on the eight prespecified scenarios.

authorization.scope: 4992 confirmation episodes and final integrity/statistical summaries; no optimizer updates

failure_handling.execution: Any failed episode stops new dispatch; running episodes finish. Preserve errors and completed results.
failure_handling.restart: Only unchanged frozen jobs may resume after an infrastructure failure. Deterministic scientific failure requires review, not silent exclusion.
failure_handling.missing_primary: Do not issue a complete primary estimate when an expected primary outcome is missing or nonfinite.
failure_handling.conditional_secondary: Retain null reasons and denominators; compare on complete paired worlds for that conditional metric, never average away a missing fitted seed.

claim_ceiling: Paired simulation performance for the registered measurement-level model and the nine retained trained fits; the study does not estimate variability from an unlimited population of future training seeds.

estimands.name: primary
estimands.aggregation: mean of three fixed fitted seeds within world; mean worlds within scenario; equal mean across eight scenarios

estimands.name: secondary
estimands.metrics: the 19 previously defined physical and accounting quantities
estimands.contrasts: all prespecified method-minus-numerical-search and integrated-agent factorial contrasts; descriptive intervals

independent_unit_definition: One simulator seed generates the shared exogenous target, nuisance, emission and transport law; all policies and retained fitted seeds remain paired within that world.

treatments.matrix: integrated: four numeric/feedback cells; Deep Sets and Set Transformer: fixed/no-feedback and generated/feedback

negative.mechanism_controls: fixed numeric parameters and feedback disabled cells, already executed on development worlds

analysis_plan.bootstrap: stratified paired-world percentile bootstrap; fitted models held fixed
analysis_plan.reporting: Report all scenarios, all three fitted seeds, metric units and conditional denominators. Do not select scenarios using confirmation outcomes.
analysis_plan.primary_decision: Upper primary 95% interval below zero supports lower mean GOSPA; upper bound at or below -5 m supports the prespecified practically useful improvement.
analysis_plan.stopping: Fixed 192 worlds; no outcome-based early stopping or sample-size extension.

minimum_effects.rationale: Prespecified practical reporting threshold equal to 2 percent of the 250 m GOSPA cutoff; not a launch or sample-selection criterion.

sample_size_plan.size_rule: Retain the previously planned 192 new worlds, 24 in each scenario, all 26 configurations per world.

power_or_sensitivity.bound_basis: Independent bounded world differences in [-250 sqrt(3),250 sqrt(3)], from at most three truths and three retained tracks; Hoeffding halfwidth. Empirical sensitivity is a planning approximation, not guaranteed power.

multiplicity.primary_family: One primary comparison on one primary metric at two-sided 95 percent confidence.
multiplicity.secondary_family: Fixed descriptive interval family; no familywise superiority claim from unadjusted secondary intervals.

fidelity_description: Measurement-level, link-budget and thermal-noise model with scenario-specific occlusion, availability and transport processes.

embargo.separation: Training, validation, development and confirmation world seeds are pairwise disjoint; confirmation output directory absent at freeze.
embargo.monitoring: Operational status and fixed outcome collection are permitted after freeze. No adaptation of models, job matrix or analysis from partial outcomes.

A0.reason: 1664 complete development episodes, 64 independent worlds, finite complete primary outcomes; exact metric control values passed.

A1.reason: Eight executed scenarios; development GOSPA range is nonconstant.

A2.reason: Primary outcomes vary below the mathematical upper bound; matched-only metric nulls have explicit reasons and paired denominators. Missed and false target penalties checked separately.

A3.reason: Distinct fixed/generated and feedback treatment cells are executable and evaluated; observed scenario-level paired changes exceed the reporting threshold in magnitude.

A4.reason: Executed near/transition/far range, emitter/illuminator attenuation, intermittency, outage and transport/occlusion ladder. Claim is confined to the same declared measurement model.

A5.reason: Six exact primary-metric controls and 80 resource replays passed; analytic/numerical baselines and all four mechanism cells already executed on development.

launch_gate.reason: Finite checks, source and checkpoint bindings, disjoint unopened worlds and fixed analysis established before generation.

digest_convention: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN; exclude only top-level freeze_digest.
